rubric.description: Assess only whether the answer is supported by the supplied sources for production Parcel API 2.0 Basic POST /labels. The applicable original manual establishes a 20-label creation limit; Pro, sandbox, older-version and status-lookup values do not establish a different limit for this integration. Accept a concise answer citing the applicable original manual or a fuller comparison that resolves the relevant conditions. A direct original-source answer need not recount every historical figure or secondary citation chain. Precise links to original evidence can establish dates and conditions without repeating their dates in prose. Any additional factual or sourcing claims must also be supported. Copied summaries are not independent confirmation, and a sandbox observation does not establish production behavior. Reject a wrong limit, unsupported production support, confused conditions or a claim of independent corroboration that the supplied citation chain contradicts. Do not assess application implementation, report creation, delegation or exhaustive source narration.

examples.reply: No. The [production 2.0 manual](sources/manual-v2.md) limits Basic POST /labels requests to 20 labels; 50 is the Pro limit. The [1.0 cap](sources/manual-v1.md) was 10, and the [release notes](sources/release-notes.md) say the 2.0 values replace it. The October change affected status latency, not creation limits. Those headlines are not independent observations of production Basic support. Submit the 50 labels as requests of 20, 20 and 10.
examples.reason: The fuller answer resolves each figure under its actual conditions, traces the copied claims and cites their original support. It reaches the same correct production Basic limit as the concise answer without claiming an unprovided test.
